scope: Continuous regional 3D kinematic geological histories with vertical drained compaction and prescribed effective-pressure profiles. These gates supplement, and do not alter, the existing numerical plan.
representation: Ordered regional events evaluated on demand at world-space vertical rays; fault inverse maps transfer material between different x/y locations. Output sampling never becomes authoritative material state.
required: Uniform cases reduce to the existing exact column deposition/compaction/slicing laws
Oblique faults agree with independent inverse point maps in full x/y/z
Faults, erosion and compaction retain bed identity, constituents and irreversible material memories
Per-ray local constituent budgets close with absolute1e-9 plus relative1e-11 of the compared grain thicknesses
Regional boundary continuation is explicit; displayed-box totals are numerical integrals and must not be labelled exact closed-volume inventories
Compaction does not expand previously compacted grains or rescale their inventory
Vertical material refinements20/10/5m converge against an independently integrated constitutive reference
Crossline-uniform cases give identical rays at every y; nonuniform histories vary along strike
Native and deterministic Wasm outputs agree on frozen requests
Output grids and replay requests query the same history; coarser rendering must not change the physical model
Existing52Rust tests, worker checks, TypeScript checks and build remain passing

performance.method: Separate fresh processes per engine/workload, one warmup plus three trials, fixed requests and identical output hashes. Separate model evaluation, projection and serialization where measurable. Native and browser results reported separately.
performance.target: Sub-second simplified 3D geological previews and seconds for moderate histories are research targets, not guarantees.
performance.restrictions: No relaxed arithmetic, mass repairs, tolerance relaxation or silent physical-resolution changes for timing gains. No observational holdout data. No SOTA superiority claim without matched downstream evidence.
